# Thermalyn Pro launch creative

## 1. Copy

The "40% off energy bills" headline isn't used. The pilot shows a median 18% reduction in HVAC energy use, and HVAC is about 40% of a typical site's bill. Details are in the note in section 4.

**Footnote (used wherever a savings claim appears):** "Based on a 2025 pilot of 48 small-business sites. Results vary." (63 characters)

### Landing-page hero

| Element | Copy | Count |
|---|---|---|
| H1 | A thermostat that learns your opening hours | 7 words (limit 8) |
| Subhead | Schedules that learn your opening hours, staff changes capped at ±2°F, and an alert when a door is left open with the HVAC running. | 24 words (limit 25) |
| CTA button | Get Thermalyn Pro | 3 words, 17 characters |
| Price line | $149 launch price (list $179) + $8/month per location for Corbel Cloud. Through Jan 31, 2026. | n/a |
| Proof line | Median 18% less HVAC energy use in a 48-site pilot.¹ 44 of 48 sites found it easier than their old thermostat. | n/a |
| Footnote | ¹ Based on a 2025 pilot of 48 small-business sites. Results vary. | 63 characters |

### Meta feed ad (1080×1080)

| Element | Copy | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Headline | A thermostat that learns your hours | 35 characters (limit 40) |
| Primary text | Median 18% less HVAC energy use in a 48-site pilot. $149 launch price + $8/mo per location. Ends Jan 31. | 104 characters (limit 125) |
| On-image text | Median 18% less HVAC energy use | 6 words (limit 6) |
| On-image footnote (required disclosure) | Based on a 2025 pilot of 48 small-business sites. Results vary. | Separate legal line, not creative copy |

### Google responsive search ad

| Element | Copy | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Headline 1 | Thermostat for small business | 29 (limit 30) |
| Headline 2 | Learns your opening hours | 25 (limit 30) |
| Headline 3 | $149 + $8/mo per location | 25 (limit 30) |
| Description 1 | Staff can't change it beyond ±2°F. Get an alert when a door is open with the HVAC on. | 85 (limit 90) |
| Description 2 | Launch price $149 through Jan 31, 2026, plus $8/month per location for Corbel Cloud. | 84 (limit 90) |

The search ad makes no savings claim on purpose. The required footnote is 63 characters, which can't fit in a 90-character description alongside a claim. The landing page carries the claim.

## 2. Layout and visual direction

### Landing-page hero (1200×630)

- **Hierarchy:**
  1. H1, Inter bold, about 50px, Deep Spruce.
  2. Subhead, about 20px.
  3. Amber CTA button.
  4. Price line directly under the button, so the subscription is never separated from the $149.
  5. Proof line.
  6. Footnote.
- **Layout:** Text sits in a left column about 700px wide. The right column holds the visual.
- **Imagery:** Use a real small-business interior, such as a café counter or salon wall, with the device on the wall in sharp focus and the room softly blurred. Don't use stock "smart home" gradients. If photography isn't ready, use the product render on a Spruce panel, as in the mock-up.
- **Colour:**
  - Paper `#F7F5F0` is the background.
  - Deep Spruce `#1F4D3A` is used for all text and the image panel.
  - Signal Amber `#F2A93B` is reserved for the CTA, the one alert chip and a thin accent rule. Amber is never used for text on Paper.
  - The CTA is Amber with Spruce text, which has about 4.7:1 contrast.
- **Footnote:** It sits at the bottom-left of the hero, in the same viewport as the claim. It is at least 13px, in Spruce, and linked from the ¹ marker.

### Meta ad (1080×1080)

- **Hierarchy:** The on-image claim is the largest element, followed by the product, then the footnote. The headline and price sit in the feed text, not on the image.
- **Layout:** The top 60% is a photo of a café or salon with the thermostat on the wall. The bottom 40% is a solid Deep Spruce panel.
- **Text:** "Median 18% less HVAC energy use" is set in Inter bold at about 72px in Paper. A short Amber rule sits above it.
- **Colour:** Spruce and Paper dominate. Amber appears only as the rule, so the ad reads as quiet and confident.
- **Footnote:** It sits at the bottom of the Spruce panel, in Paper at about 22px, inside a 60px safe margin. It spans one line and is left-aligned with the claim.

## 4. Note to product marketing

**Changes to the brief**

- **Headline:** I dropped "Cut your energy bills by 40%." The pilot median was 18% of HVAC energy. The 40% figure is HVAC's share of the bill, and only one site reached 41%. At the median, the total bill falls roughly 7%. The copy now says "median 18% less HVAC energy use", with the footnote.
- **Price:** $149 is always shown with $8/month per location, because schedules and alerts need Corbel Cloud.
- **Season:** The pilot ran June to September, which is cooling season. Launch is in winter, so I'd run a heating-season follow-up.
- **Quote:** I left out Jane's $210 quote. It comes from one site and doesn't say what was reduced.
